verdict.rationale: Individual SKILL.md files and the docs/skills.md catalog document what each skill does across many skills (review, qa, ship, office-hours, autoplan, cso, upgrade, learn, investigate). Activation conditions are documented only in places: QA voice triggers, the router skill that dispatches requests, and domain skills injected into prompt context for a matching host. missing for 10: evidence that every skill documents its activation triggers, coverage of the auto-learning and auto-upgrade side effects in a predictable per-skill format, independent corroboration that the docs let users predict behavior.

support.subject: As a developer, every skill documents what it does and when it activates, so I can predict my agent's new behavior before it surprises me

citations.quote: Analyzes diff against the base branch for SQL safety, LLM trust boundary violations, conditional side effects, and other structural issues.
Ship workflow: detect + merge base branch, run tests, review diff, bump VERSION, update CHANGELOG, commit, push, create PR.
Voice triggers (speech-to-text aliases): "quality check", "test the app", "run QA".
Sends any gstack request to the right skill (planning, review, QA, shipping, debugging, docs, security, design).
future sessions on that host get the note injected into their prompt context.
